tool.name: Webatlas Build config
tool.command: ## TODO: figure out inputs, implement --options ln -s "$input_img_metadata_1" input_img_metadata_1.json && python "${__tool_directory__}/build_config.py" --project $project --dataset $dataset --file_paths $input_zarr.extra_files_path/$input_zarr.metadata.store_root/ --images '{"label": [{"path": "$input_img_1.extra_files_path/$input_img_1.metadata.store_root/", "md": "input_img_metadata_1.json"}]}' --url $url --layout $layout --title $title --config_filename_suffix $config_filename_suffix && mv $project-$dataset-'$config_filename_suffix'.json $output_json

param.name: input_zarr
param.label: Zarr file generated by 'Webatlas Process files'

section.name: input_section_1
section.title: Image file and corresponding metadata file

param.name: input_img_1
param.label: Zarr file generated by 'Webatlas Consolidate Metadata'

param.name: input_img_metadata_1
param.label: JSON file generated by 'Webatlas OME Zarr Metadata'

param.name: url
param.label: url
param.help: URL to prepend to each file in the config file. The URL to the local or remote server that will serve the files.

param.name: layout
param.label: Layout
param.help: Type of predefined layout to use.

param.name: custom_layout
param.label: Custom layout
param.help: String defining a Vitessce layout following its alternative syntax. https://vitessce.github.io/vitessce-python/api_config.html#vitessce.config.VitessceConfig.layout https://github.com/vitessce/vitessce-python/blob/1e100e4f3f6b2389a899552dffe90716ffafc6d5/vitessce/config.py#L855

param.name: title
param.label: Title
param.help: Data title to show in the visualization.
